confirmationSetPolicy: Do not decode, infer, label or evaluate the six reserved confirmation songs in E4

methods.full: Frozen v558 adjacent-frame spectral-flux candidate residual copied through v560
methods.ddcOfficial: Frozen v560 official DDC Challenge peak candidate residual
methods.fusion: If ddcOfficialResidualMs is present, use it; otherwise use fullResidualMs; no threshold, offset, phase or candidate changes

candidateMatching: Inherited unchanged from frozen v560: nearest candidate within +/-10 ms around reference + frozen globalDelay + frozen actual cross-fit top2/DP phase

transitionDefinitions.fixed: full is not correct and fusion is correct against provisional clear/approximate label within +/-5 ms
transitionDefinitions.broken: full is correct and fusion is not correct against the same label
transitionDefinitions.bothCorrect: full and fusion are both correct
transitionDefinitions.bothIncorrect: neither full nor fusion is correct; missing candidates are incorrect for this transition analysis

hypotheses.H1: Frozen fusion improves all-object +/-5 ms correct rate and clear+approximate recall over full
hypotheses.H2: DDC overrides fix more population-weighted full errors than they break full-correct objects
hypotheses.H3: Fusion and all transition diagnostics can be recomputed deterministically from frozen v560 candidates without new inference or parameter fitting

testPolicy: Exactly one fusion rule is frozen before reading E4 metrics; no post-hoc threshold, fallback, offset, phase or availability retuning in v561
